arguments.command:
cd $PWD; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/conversation.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""			const { text, toolCalls, stopReason, usedTools } =
				await this.options.thread.answerText(record.answer, record.entry);""","""			// An input submission always has its entry; without one, the range is just the answer.
			const input = record.entry ?? record.answer;
			const { text, toolCalls, stopReason, usedTools } =
				await this.options.thread.answerText(record.answer, input);""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm run fix >/dev/null 2>&1; npm run check 2>&1 | grep -E "error|Tests |thread.ts|conversation.ts|clones|ERROR"
